rust_summary: A player enchanted an item at an enchanting table (`native_player_enchant_item`).
doc_summary: A server player enchanted an item at an enchanting table, in `EnchantmentMenu.clickMenuButton`: `native_player_enchant_item(player, player_entity_id, item, enchantments)`, with the player's UUID and entity id, the enchanted stack (an enchanted book for a book) and the enchantments it was given as (id, level), in order. Fires after the levels are paid, before `enchant_item`. Server-side, not cancellable. Bundles need "hooks": @API:player_enchant_item@.
